mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter indicates a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 decreases > 1% QoQ.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points month-over-month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases > 0.3pp MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases over three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (GDPC1) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a strengthening demand side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and GDPC1 both increase > 2% MoM
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where both HOUST and GDPC1 increase > 2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) is below 3.5%, the tight monetary policy coupled with a strong labor market leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 month-over-month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS decreases > 100k MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Retail and Food Services Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where RSAFS increases over three consecutive months.
